title: Daily Electronic Transfer and Withdrawal Limits
content: Customers using digital online banking are subject to a daily electronic transfer limit of $2,500 for external ACH and P2P transfers. ATM cash withdrawals are limited to $1,000 per card per 24-hour cycle. Bank staff may authorize temporary limit increases up to $10,000 upon positive identity verification. Permanent limit increases or single transfers exceeding $10,000 strictly require manager/approver review.
